buildCommand: npm run build && mkdir -p .vercel/output/static && if [ -d dist ]; then cp -r dist/. .vercel/output/static/; else echo 'no dist/ on disk — vite must have written directly to .vercel/output/static/; listing:'; ls -la .vercel/output/static/; fi && printf '%s' '{"version":3,"routes":[{"handle":"filesystem"},{"src":"/(.*)","dest":"/index.html"}]}' > .vercel/output/config.json
